AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animal Health: Parasite control? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animal Health: Parasite control.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animal Health: Parasite control.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animal Health: Parasite control.

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. joule (J)

4. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Vegetative propagation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Vegetative propagation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Vegetative propagation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Vegetative propagation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Vegetative propagation.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Aquaculture? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Aquaculture.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Aquaculture.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Aquaculture.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Inorganic fertilisers? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Inorganic fertilisers.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Inorganic fertilisers.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Inorganic fertilisers.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Agroforestry? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Agroforestry.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Agroforestry.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Agroforestry.

9. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water conservation.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Structures in Animal production? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Structures in Animal production.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Structures in Animal production.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Structures in Animal production.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Crop Production Structures? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Crop Production Structures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Crop Production Structures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Crop Production Structures.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetative propagation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Agroforestry and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Protection: Pest control and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Crop Production Structures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

2. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animal Health: Parasite control.

3. A — newton (N)

4. C — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

5. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Vegetative propagation.

6. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Aquaculture.

7. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Inorganic fertilisers.

8. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Agroforestry.

9. C — Producers

10. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water conservation.

11. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Structures in Animal production.

12. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Crop Production Structures.
